policy.note: Lateral/overlap/perimeter are declared trial policies, not physical laws. The explicit lateral fraction permits a bounded contact experiment, not a material-feasibility claim. The 5 mm minimum teddy/left-robot clearance is an engineering preflight allowance, not a physical law. Bottom clearance and lateral trial fraction are configurable; no compression is prescribed.

geometry_guarantees: Uses the ordered actual 3D body rim, not a fitted mouth plane.
The observed teddy is translated without imposed compression or rotation.
Thin-slab convex envelopes enclose every horizontal section between tetra vertex-height events.
Whole observed teddy begins above highest rim by at least 40 mm and ends below lowest rim by 2 mm, with configured table clearance.
The complete frozen-shape vertical teddy sweep must clear every left robot collision volume by the declared engineering allowance.
Robot path retains analytic continuous joint-limit and sampled 8 mm rigid-clearance checks.
not_guaranteed: Deformable 3D bag interior containment or passage under contact.
Frictional grasp retention, force/torque, cloth strain or tetrahedron quality during execution.
A nonplanar rim can contact several teddy heights simultaneously; independent section guards do not certify that coupled contact.
Overlap fraction is a bounded trial heuristic for slab envelopes, not an exact occupied-section or continuous-contact theorem.
Saved observations lack native contact force/torque; runtime guards and final containment audit are mandatory.

topology.body_face_selection: explicit physical body-face labels mapped to imported rest mesh

left_robot_teddy_sweep.model_scope: continuous frozen tetrahedral body versus MuJoCo convex collision solids
limitations: Does not predict deformation, friction, grasp retention or contact forces.
Robot convex envelopes can overestimate nonconvex native collision surfaces.
Left pose is fixed at measured q; native affine compliance and future tracking are not included.
Only the declared vertical segment is certified; raise/XY transport and other obstacles require separate gates.
A fresh actual-shape check remains necessary after physical preparation.
